text.combat.npc_died: The rat gives one last shudder and lies still.
text.combat.npc_hit: The rat sinks its teeth into you.
text.combat.npc_miss: The rat snaps at you, but finds only air.
text.combat.player_died: You crumple to the floor. You awaken at the shrine.
text.combat.player_hit: Your blow strikes the rat squarely.
text.combat.player_miss: The rat darts clear of your blow.
text.dialogue.bram.prompt: Bram looks at the lantern, then at you. "Will you keep it for now, or leave it with me?"
text.dialogue.bram_offer.prompt: Bram keeps his eyes on the reeds. "My lantern’s beside the well, and I can’t leave the ferry. Would you fetch it?"
text.dialogue.maud_offer.prompt: “Clear the five rats out of my cellar and I’ll give you the key to the storage chest upstairs.”
text.dialogue.maud_turn_in.prompt: “Well? Have you dealt with those rats?”
text.item.brass_key.description: A small brass key with a narrow tooth.
text.item.brass_key.room: A small [brass key] lies here, its narrow tooth glinting.
text.item.cellar_key.description: An iron key, its bow worn smooth.
text.item.lantern.description: Dented brass with a horn window, oil sloshing inside.
text.item.lantern.room: A [brass lantern] rests beside the well.
text.item.storage_chest.description: A wooden chest with an iron lock.
text.item.tin_whistle.description: A small tin whistle, dulled by dust.
text.item.tin_whistle.room: A small [tin whistle] lies in the trunk.
text.item.trunk.description: An old wooden trunk. Its iron hasp is dark with age.
text.item.trunk.room: An old [trunk] sits under the slope of the roof.
text.item.wool_cloak.description: Heavy grey wool. Rain runs off it.
text.item.wool_cloak.room: A [wool cloak] hangs over the bedpost.
text.narration.bram.accept: You say you'll fetch it. Bram nods toward the path north.
text.narration.bram.carry: You keep the lantern. Bram nods once.
text.narration.bram.leave: You hand Bram the lantern. He settles it beside his boot.
text.narration.maud.accept: You agree to clear Maud’s cellar.
text.narration.maud.done: Maud sets an iron key in your palm. “For the storage chest upstairs. You’ve earned it.”
text.npc.bram.description: A ferryman with rope-scarred hands and a coat that has never been dry.
text.npc.bram.room: [Old Bram] the ferryman stands here, one boot on the ferry.
text.npc.cellar_rat.description: A small grey rat watches from beside a barrel, its whiskers twitching.
text.npc.cellar_rat_1.room: A [[cellar_rat_1|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
text.npc.cellar_rat_2.room: A [[cellar_rat_2|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
text.npc.cellar_rat_3.room: A [[cellar_rat_3|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
text.npc.cellar_rat_4.room: A [[cellar_rat_4|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
text.npc.cellar_rat_5.room: A [[cellar_rat_5|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
text.npc.maud.description: Broad, floury, sharp-eyed. She has been widowed by the river and has not forgiven it.
text.npc.maud.room: [Widow Maud] is here behind the bar, wiping a mug that is already clean.
text.quest.lantern.carried: You found the lantern and kept it.
text.quest.lantern.title: Bram's lantern
text.quest.mauds_cellar.active: Clear the five rats from the Lantern cellar.
text.quest.mauds_cellar.ready: The five cellar rats are dead. Return to Maud at the Drowned Lantern.
text.quest.mauds_cellar.resolved: You cleared Maud’s cellar and received the storage key.
text.quest.mauds_cellar.title: Maud’s Cellar
text.room.chapel_nave.description: The nave is cold and high. A fresco covers the east wall, and the altar is plain stone.
text.room.chapel_nave.title: Chapel Nave
text.room.chapel_steps.description: Wide stone steps, worn into dips, climb to the chapel door. An alms bowl sits on the top step.
text.room.chapel_steps.title: Chapel Steps
text.room.drowned_lantern.description: The inn is low and warm and smells of peat smoke and spilled ale. The hearth is big enough to stand in. The rumor board is thick with pinned notes, and Maud’s bar runs along the back wall.
text.room.drowned_lantern.title: The Drowned Lantern
text.room.ferry_landing.description: Reeds crowd a slick wooden landing, and the river slides past it the color of strong tea. A mooring post leans into the current with a notice nailed to it. Tide marks stripe the pilings.
text.room.ferry_landing.title: Ferry Landing
text.room.inn_attic.description: Dust lies thick as felt. A trunk with an iron hasp sits under the slope of the roof.
text.room.inn_attic.title: Inn Attic
text.room.inn_rooms.description: A narrow passage of doors under the eaves. One stands open on a bed made up tight, and a window over the green. The ceiling sags a little at the end of the passage.
text.room.inn_rooms.title: Inn Rooms
text.room.lantern_cellar.description: Ale casks lie on their sides in cradles. The floor is gritty, and the air tastes of old beer. Rat holes gnaw the base of every wall.
text.room.lantern_cellar.title: Lantern Cellar
text.room.north_gate.description: The north gate is oak banded with iron, set in the village wall. North, a track climbs to the priory.
text.room.north_gate.title: North Gate
text.room.village_green.description: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass at the heart of Ashmere. The stocks stand empty, and a market cross of weathered stone marks the middle.
text.room.village_green.title: Village Green
text.room.well_lane.description: A cobbled lane climbs from the landing toward the green. In the middle stands the well, with a bucket on a chain. The Drowned Lantern’s sign creaks to the east.
text.room.well_lane.title: Well Lane
text.scene.lantern_kept.bram: Bram settles his boot against the ferry. The wet rope creaks around the mooring post.
text.scene.lantern_kept.brass: You turn the brass lantern in your hand. Its dented side is cool against your palm.
text.scene.lantern_kept.river: The reeds stir. The river keeps sliding past the landing, the color of strong tea.
